title: Portuguese Chicken Flatbread
description: A flavorful flatbread dish topped with tender chicken and a tangy sauce, inspired by the bold flavors of Portugal.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest.
Brush the flatbread slices with olive oil and toast in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Mix the zesty sauce with minced garlic.
Top the toasted flatbread slices with the cooked chicken, zesty sauce, and any desired toppings.
